section: Inhibitor Alkyne-PEG4-amine Contributes to Cobalt Superfilling
text: Article Recommendations ABSTRACT: In the field of electronic plating, the addition of additives is the key to achieve cobalt superfilling, while finding and researching suitable additives is a major challenge. In this work, alkyne-PEG4-amine (AP4A) was used as an inhibitor to achieve nanometer scale superfilling of cobalt electrodeposition. The inhibition of AP4A was analyzed by electrochemical methods, including cyclic voltammetry and chronopotentiometry tests.

text: In this work, we propose a cobalt electrodeposition additive which can be used for superfilling. The inhibition efect of alkyne-PEG4-amine (AP4A) was investigated by electrochemical methods, including cyclic voltammetry and chronopotentiometry. Quantum chemical calculations were applied to confirm the inhibition efect of the AP4A molecule on electrodeposition. The results of the cobalt electrodeposition experiment showed that AP4A has significant influence on electrical properties, surface morphology, and crystal structure.

text: In this work, the feasibility for achieving superfilling with additives is assessed by electrochemical experiments and quantum chemical calculations in the first place, which is verified by practical filling of electrodeposition. This research successfully identifies an additive molecule that can be used for cobalt superfilling and investigates its inhibition mechanism as well as its film properties, providing helpful insights into the relationship between molecule and microstructure, which is meaningful for realizing high-quality nanoscale cobalt inter connections and for the search of other potential additives.
